newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May unemployment rate rises to 6 pct - BGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May unemployment rate rises to 6 pct - BGE.

text.p: Brazil's unemployment rate rose to 6.0 percent in May from 5.75 percent in April, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The unemployment rate was also up from May 1996, when it stood at 5.91 percent, the IBGE said.
The number of people working rose 0.4 percent from April to May, while the number of people out of work increased 4.7 percent in the six main urban centers surveyed, the IBGE said.
The unemployment rate rose most in Recife, Salvador and Belo Horizonte, it said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
